defaults.composition: A foreground of moss, ferns or young leaves along the bottom edge, a middle ground of spaced tree trunks standing across the frame, and a background of brighter woodland and sky glimpsed through the canopy; the view looks sideways through an open, airy wood, with any path curving across the frame.

shots.subject: An open beech wood in fresh leaf, smooth silver-grey trunks spaced widely across a gentle slope, low branches covered in new green leaves and a thin morning haze among the trees.
shots.motion_elements: the young beech leaves and the thin morning haze

shots.subject: A sunlit birch grove on a gentle slope, white trunks with pale green catkins and small new leaves, and a soft grassy floor with scattered white wood anemones.
shots.motion_elements: the birch leaves and catkins

shots.subject: A mixed oak and hazel woodland edge in low evening light, young leaves glowing pale green, a mossy bank in front and long trunk shadows lying across the grass.
shots.motion_elements: the glowing young leaves and the grass

shots.subject: A quiet beech wood under a soft grey sky, loose patches of bluebells between young ferns, tall smooth trunks and a fresh green canopy overhead.
shots.motion_elements: the fern fronds and the canopy leaves

shots.subject: A damp woodland hollow after rain, mossy boulders, unfurling ferns, rain-darkened oak trunks in early leaf and a faint mist rising between the trees.
shots.motion_elements: the rising mist and the unfurling ferns

shots.subject: A hillside wood of young larch in pale new needles, a soft grassy clearing in front and morning light filtering through thin mist between the trunks.
shots.motion_elements: the thin mist and the larch boughs

shots.subject: A wide woodland glade of fresh grass, a few old oak trees in new leaf around its edge and loose drifts of Queen Anne's lace along the shade line.
shots.motion_elements: the fresh grass and the Queen Anne's lace

shots.subject: A narrow footpath curving sideways across a slope through a hazel coppice, pale yellow primroses on the bank and warm light slanting through the new leaves.
shots.motion_elements: the hazel leaves and the moving dappled light

shots.subject: A low rolling woodland of hornbeam and beech with a thick moss floor, a few fallen branches lying across it and pale green leaves under even soft light.
shots.motion_elements: the pale green leaves

shots.subject: A wet spring wood beside a small brook, glistening ferns, moss-covered roots, tall ash trees in early leaf and droplets catching the light on the undergrowth.
shots.motion_elements: the small brook and the glistening ferns

shots.subject: A fern-filled clearing in a mixed woodland at sunrise, dew on the young bracken shoots, birch and rowan trunks around it and a pale glow behind the trees.
shots.motion_elements: the dewy bracken shoots and the rowan leaves

shots.subject: A beech wood on a gentle slope with bright translucent new leaves, smooth grey trunks across the frame and a floor of last year's copper leaves pierced by fresh green shoots.
shots.motion_elements: the translucent new leaves

shots.subject: A woodland edge opening onto a grassy meadow, hawthorn bushes in white blossom along the margin, tall oaks behind and long golden light over the grass.
shots.motion_elements: the meadow grass and the hawthorn blossom

shots.subject: A wild garlic woodland floor under tall ash and sycamore, broad green leaves with small white star flowers in loose patches and a mossy fallen log lying across the frame.
shots.motion_elements: the wild garlic leaves

shots.subject: A green woodland slope after rain with moss-covered stones, a shallow rivulet running diagonally across the frame, young sycamores in leaf and soft mist in the background.
shots.motion_elements: the shallow rivulet and the soft mist

shots.subject: A spaced pine and birch wood with a carpet of bilberry shoots, light mist hanging at mid-height and pale sunlight slanting softly between the trunks.
shots.motion_elements: the hanging mist and the bilberry shoots

shots.subject: A broad open woodland of old oaks with wide crowns of new pale green leaves, a short-grass floor and dappled sunlight patches drifting across the ground.
shots.motion_elements: the oak leaves and the dappled light patches

shots.subject: A wild cherry tree in white blossom at the edge of a beech wood, fresh grass and dandelion clocks in front and warm low sun shining between the trunks.
shots.motion_elements: the cherry blossom branches and the grass

shots.subject: A soft woodland of young alder and willow on damp ground, catkins hanging from the branches, tussocks of fresh sedge and a calm grey sky showing through the canopy.
shots.motion_elements: the hanging catkins and the sedge

shots.subject: A dripping beech canopy over a mossy forest floor after a shower, a faint path curving left across the frame, raindrops on young leaves and clearing light in the distance.
shots.motion_elements: the dripping young beech leaves

shots.subject: A woodland stream bank at dawn with soft mist over the water, mossy roots of old oaks, pale green hazel thickets and a scatter of wood sorrel on the bank.
shots.motion_elements: the soft mist and the hazel leaves

shots.subject: A bright birch and rowan wood with tall grass, scattered yellow celandines and lady ferns in the foreground, sunlit young leaves and blue sky between the crowns.
shots.motion_elements: the tall grass and the lady ferns

shots.subject: A hillside of young oak and holly woodland with mossy stone outcrops, low warm light skimming the moss and pale new leaves fluttering on the lower branches.
shots.motion_elements: the pale new leaves

shots.subject: A low mossy dry-stone wall winding across the frame through a quiet woodland of ash and hazel, ferns at its foot and fresh green leaves overhead.
shots.motion_elements: the ferns and the overhead leaves

shots.subject: A woodland clearing after rain with a shallow puddle reflecting the canopy, wet grass, mossy tree stumps and young beech saplings in fresh leaf.
shots.motion_elements: the puddle reflections and the wet grass

shots.subject: A gentle valley side of mixed woodland seen across a dip, the trees in many shades of new green, a soft blanket of mist in the hollow and a pale morning sky above.
shots.motion_elements: the mist in the hollow

shots.subject: A woodland of tall straight beeches with a bright green understory of young beech saplings, a soft floor of moss and patches of sky through the canopy.
shots.motion_elements: the young sapling leaves

shots.subject: A sloping woodland margin with wild crab apple trees in pale pink blossom, tall oak trunks behind and warm golden light coming through the long grass.
shots.motion_elements: the pink blossom branches and the long grass

shots.subject: A lush fern floor in an oak wood, hundreds of unfurling fronds around mossy boulders and pale grey light falling evenly between the trunks.
shots.motion_elements: the unfurling fern fronds

shots.subject: A damp woodland in spring where every trunk and branch is covered in green moss, polypody ferns along the limbs and soft mist drifting after rain.
shots.motion_elements: the drifting mist and the polypody ferns

shots.subject: A grassy woodland ride curving from left to right between birch and oak, dew on the grass, Queen Anne's lace along the edges and pale morning light from the side.
shots.motion_elements: the dewy grass and the Queen Anne's lace

shots.subject: A bright mixed woodland of beech, lime and hazel on a slope, small patches of bluebells and white anemones between moss and a breeze moving through the fresh canopy.
shots.motion_elements: the fresh canopy leaves
